workflows.description: Extract routes, parameters, and declared identity gates from the supplied source copy
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Send one same-origin baseline request per in-scope route using the declared method
prerequisites: Authorized same-origin requests through p2o_http on the confirmed origin, with the method, headers, cookies and body the approved scope declares.

workflows.description: Reach protected routes with a controlled authenticated identity; a browser session is not a substitute
prerequisites: Operator-supplied authorized credentials for controlled authenticated principals, used only inside the confirmed origin.
